slides.title: Myth: "Facebook ke *leads sab fake* hote hain"
slides.sub: Har builder ne ye bola hai. Sach kya hai? Swipe →

slides.title: Fact: zyaadatar lead *fake nahi*, *thandi* hoti hai
slides.sub: Insaan ne scroll karte hue form bhara. 2 din baad call aaya to use yaad bhi nahi.
slides.box:
"Maine kab form bhara?" = fake nahi.
Iska matlab reply der se gaya.

slides.title: Galti 1: form *bahut aasaan*
slides.sub: Sirf naam + number = koi bhi tap kar deta hai.
slides.box:
Form mein 2 sawaal jodo:
Budget kitna? Kaunsa area?
Leads thodi kam, par asli zyaada.

slides.title: Galti 2: *reply mein der*
slides.sub: Interest sabse zyaada form bharte waqt hota hai.
slides.box:
5 min ke andar WhatsApp: price sheet + visit slot.
Call baad mein, pehle message.

slides.title: Galti 3: ad ko *pata hi nahi* kya chahiye
slides.sub: Aap ad ko sirf "form" pe optimise karte ho.
slides.box: Jo visit pe aaye, unka data ad platform ko wapas bhejo. Ad ko pata chalega asli buyer kaisa dikhta hai.

slides.title: Aapke leads *asli* hain ya *thande*?
slides.sub: Comment karo AUDIT, hum aapka form + follow-up free check karenge.

caption:
"Facebook ke leads sab fake hote hain." Har builder ne ye bola hai. 🤔

Myth vs Fact:
❌ Zyaadatar leads fake nahi, thandi hoti hain
✅ Form mein budget + area ka sawaal jodo
✅ 5 min mein WhatsApp reply (price sheet + visit slot)
✅ Visit ka data ad platform ko wapas bhejo

Save karo 🔖 agla campaign chalane se pehle.

Comment "AUDIT" 👇 hum aapka form + follow-up free check karenge.
